items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Faces A Privacy Probe In France
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) faces a French privacy probe into its AI-powered smart glasses following recent complaints about data collection. Regulators in France are examining whether the AI glasses comply with EU data protection rules for audio and visual recording in public spaces. Meta has partnered with Shopify to integrate its Muse AI tools into agentic payments, aiming to streamline embedded checkout flows for merchants.
